subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `deferred` as a public cron/run status plus the new plugin SDK/hook lifecycle surface for yielded-parent handoff, or should the fix stay internal/narrower?
rationale: The diff is more than a private bug fix: it changes persisted status values and public plugin-facing contracts, and repository policy treats those as compatibility-sensitive choices that automation cannot approve by green tests alone.

options.title: Accept deferred as public contract
options.body: Require rebase, Discord-visible proof, and upgrade compatibility proof, then merge the broad contract deliberately.

options.title: Narrow to internal runtime behavior
options.body: Keep yielded parents from being reported as ordinary completion without adding plugin SDK or public status surface until a smaller contract is designed.

options.title: Split by existing related PRs
options.body: Close or pause this broad branch and land narrower fixes through the already-open cron, top-level session, and no-continuation PRs.

recommendation.title: Accept deferred as public contract
recommendation.body: Require rebase, Discord-visible proof, and upgrade compatibility proof, then merge the broad contract deliberately.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest available routing owner from recent subagent refactors and maintainer merge history, and the unresolved question is an owner-boundary/product contract decision.
